description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the AttributesCreated class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling related to attributes creation events.

classes.name: AttributesCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AttributesCreated event, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the AttributesCreated class is immutable and that Attributes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to check the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for AttributesCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that passing null as a string ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that passing null as a ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttributeObject
methods.description: Tests that passing null as attributes object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an AttributesCreated instance from JSON and verifies the created attributes.
